11.17.08 – We’ve added additional locations, characters and information to the site. Explore the world to see what’s new!

10.31.08 – See what happens to Sonic at night. Visit www.NightoftheWerehog.com for more details!
AVAILABLE ON THE PLAYSTATION®3, PLAYSTATION®2, XBOX 360® & Wii™!
Use the mouse to grab and spin the world. Click on a flag for information. You can set the site to day or night by clicking on the icons in the top corners – you get different content for each!

Sonic the Hedgehog is on an adventure unlike any other! Powered by an all-new game engine, Sonic Unleashed™ merges classic Sonic gameplay with the latest in next-generation innovation. Race through intriguing locations across the globe as Sonic to save a chaotic world with blistering 2D action in meticulously rendered 3D environments.

On a quest for domination once more, Dr. Eggman unleashes a slumbering beast from the center of the world. The event causes a devastating tremor that splinters the world into seven continents and triggers a hair-raising transformation in Sonic. With the world divided and Sonic altered with new abilities and powers, the stage is set for a climactic battle… for when the sun sets, a whole new adventure awakens!

KEY FEATURES
  • Sonic's World Transformed: Sonic maintains his high-speed abilities during the day, but at night he is transformed into a mysterious dark form with incredible never-before-seen abilities including 3D-action brawling and amazing agility.
  • Tight Navigation and Speed Control: Accelerate to super speed with ‘Sonic Boost’ by collecting rings to increase Sonic’s ‘Ring Energy.’ Using ‘Quick Step,’ you will quickly move left or right to avoid obstacles instantly. Additionally, ‘Speed Drift’ will rocket you through turns without slowing down.
  • Powerful New Engine and Cinematic Graphics: With its new propietary “Hedgehog Engine,” Sonic Unleashed enhances the classic 2D perspective with mind-blowing 3D stages. Other next-gen technology capabilities include global illumination, grid computing, continuous data streaming and an intricate path finding system.
  • Enhanced and Expanded Environments: Many unique and fascinating continents offer you an opportunity to save the world in a dynamic, high-speed experience. In addition to exploring exciting unlockable areas, dash through up to nine locations resembling real-life destinations including the Great Wall of China, Arctic Pole glaciers and many more.

Many unique and fascinating continents offer the player an opportunity to save the world in a dynamic, high-speed experience during the day. In addition to exploring exciting unlockable areas, players dash through locations resembling real-life destinations including the Great Wall, Arctic Pole glaciers and many more.

Sonic’s back with some all-new moves! You can now accelerate to super speed with ‘Sonic Boost’ by collecting rings to increase Sonic’s ‘Ring Energy’ level. The faster Sonic collects rings the more he can boost. Avoid obstacles instantly using “Quick Step” by allowing Sonic to strafe left or right without losing speed, and take turns at high speed by using Sonic’s new ‘Speed Drift’. So think on your feet and unleash your inner speedster!

Sonic Unleashed enhances the classic 2D perspective with mind-blowing 3D stages. As Sonic races across multiple continents you will experience a seamless transition from 2D to 3D perspective depending on the area of the stage. A perfect blend of Classic and New!

Powered by the all-new graphics engine, The Hedgehog Engine is built to handle the incredibly demanding requirements of a Sonic action game, allowing Sonic to race at incredible speeds through huge environments.

Sonic Unleashed is one of the first game graphics engines to achieve full global illumination in real-time rendering. Along with grid computing, continuous data streaming and an intricate path finding system, the new Hedgehog Engine delivers real-time graphics quality that can stand up to pre-rendered CG.

After dark, Sonic, transforms to the Werehog, and will uncover many unique and fascinating continents. While scaling walls, avoiding obstacles, fighting new enemies and uncovering hidden pathways, Sonic the Werehog will explore worldwide locations at night like never before.

Sonic maintains his high-speed abilities during the day, but at night he is transformed into a mysterious dark form with incredible never-before-seen abilities including amazing agility and 3D-action brawling! Sonic the Werehog can utilize a new Unleash mode to deal greater damage to the enemies of the night, as well as perform multiple attack moves, including the Were-Wallop Combo which sends monsters and robots flying!

In what was to be Sonic & Dr. Eggman’s final showdown, Sonic fell into Dr. Eggman’s most devious trap. Capturing the power of Sonic’s Chaos Emeralds, Dr. Eggman fires a powerful beam towards the world. With the world ripped into numerous continents, a colossal beast living in the core had been awakened. Dr. Eggman’s plan was to exploit the beast and take over the world. As a result, with increased strength, sharp claws and fangs, Sonic had been transformed into a Werehog.

What is to come of Sonic’s mysterious transformation, the fragmented planet, and the colossal beast? Has Dr. Eggman finally managed to take over the world?

Sonic is on a race against time to save the world… and himself!

Sonic is the world’s fastest supersonic hedgehog, and values freedom and life by his own rules above everything else. He is kind at heart, but can be short tempered and is quick to throw himself into the middle of trouble without a second thought, remaining steadfast to the end. His personality is a juxtaposition of kindness and ferocity, as on the one hand he does all in his power to snuff out evil, but he also can’t look away when somebody else is in trouble. Sonic hates boredom and being tied down, so much of his time is spent running towards danger or the next adventure.
This sword-swinging Egg Fighter Knight attacks Sonic with a bigger range than normal.
Since EggBeetle and Egg Devil Ray were destroyed, Dr. Eggman combined their strengths and designed the Egg Launcher Knight.
An expert aviator, Tails flies Sonic from continent to continent in his plane, the Tornado, to help him restore the fractured planet.
These aerial arsenals circle in front of Sonic, firing laser beams and missile salvos. Sometimes, they forget to keep an eye out for obstacles behind them. Whoops!
With extreme durability and a wide variety of attacks, Dr. Eggman's latest mid-sized, anti-Sonic weaponry dogs Sonic through multiple scenes.
Superheaters within these fans' bodies produce an endless stream of flame blown forth at hapless targets. Known for their hot tempers, even their fellow robots tend to keep their distance.
These critters hover along, emitting high-voltage bursts periodically. If they spot Sonic, they'll make a bee-line for him. Not even their designer is 100% sure how they float like that.
A well mannered and renowned expert in ancient literature, he will prove to be an invaluable ally and guide to Sonic.

Dr. Eggman is an evil scientific genius who boasts an IQ of 300. By skillfully luring Sonic right into a most devious trap, he was able to successfully awaken a colossal beast from the core of the planet. But will he be equally successful in taking over the world?
Chip lost his memory after Sonic’s fall from outer space so he decides to join Sonic on his world adventure to try to rediscover his identity.

As a side effect of Dr. Eggman's latest miscounduct, Sonic now undergoes an extreme physical transformation whenever the sun goes down, but his heart remains the same. Almost. Sonic the Werehog is still willing to put his life on the line for his friends without any due consideration, but his dedication to helping his new friend regain his memory is in no small part out of guilt that it was most likely his own fall from space that caused the problem in the first place.

As a Werehog, Sonic is not as fast as his usual self, but makes up for it in ferocious combat techniques. His powerful arms are able to stretch allowing him to attack enemies from a greater distance, and to reach distant ledges, poles and bars with ease.
Hiding out in eel holes around walls and ground, they attack by spitting out energy balls. Each individual D.eel has his own eel hole and lives there forever. They get very upset by intruders.
A ferocious and evil enemy, the Titan's only mission is to destroy anything that comes across its path.
Even though nighttime is not his favorite time to be out, Tails is always willing to help Sonic in his adventures.
When the world’s people harbor especially deep wellsprings of grief and anger, they give rise to these mean monsters. They're far tougher to take out than their Nightmare cousins.

Though quick to chomp, these little guys don't pack much bite, but get enough of them together and it spells trouble. They make great weapons when thrown.

Though the powered-up Red Rexes are still not the strongest, try wielding one in each hand as dual weapons.

It can be tough to get a fix on these nimble nasties long enough to land an attack. Let them get close, and they'll make a bee-line for you behind-first, and that's one point you don't want to get. It's safest to throw something at them from afar.

The Red Killer Bee is trickier: better, faster and stronger than the regular Killer Bee.

Monsters born of Dark Gaia with exceptionally high intelligence can take on a humanoid appearance like these fiends. While their control of lightning makes these mages a threat from afar, they resort to clumsily waving their staffs around when cornered.
Extremely brilliant and refined, the Professor is happy to share his knowledge over a cucumber sandwich.

Dr. Eggman is an evil scientific genius who boasts an IQ of 300. By skillfully luring Sonic right into a most devious trap, he was able to successfully awaken a colossal beast from the core of the planet. But will he be equally successful in taking over the world?
Though he is a little afraid of the dark, Chip continues on as he must find out who he is and where he came from.
With a lovely ocean backdrop, this port town marks the start of Sonic's adventure.
The world's art capital and home to a university that attracts those in search of knowledge.
This small town in the mountains has passed down its pork bun recipe for generations.
A town of ruins and ancient customs, now celebrating the Feast of Sun and Moon.
The village is an architectural marvel, built atop the water in a jungle strewn with ancient ruins.

Exotic wild animals are a frequent sight near this village built on reddish-brown soil.
(Available only on the PLAYSTATION 3 & Xbox 360)
Covered in snow, this northern land is gripped by extreme cold and dotted with houses built out of ice.
A melting pot of diverse folk and ideas. All who come here dream of making it big.
With a few swipes, both barriers and enemies are sent skidding across the stone courtyards in this seaside town.
Using his stretchy arms and firm grip, Sonic the Werehog can escape enemies by climbing up the sides of the ancient stone buildings.
No enemy is out of reach in this ornate and beautiful city for Sonic the Werehog, including those that are airborne.

His new-found brute strength allows Sonic the Werehog to knock down columns to create a path and hurtle pots and other objects at enemies. He must also be quick on his paws to dodge giant club-wielding monsters.
Torches light the wooden pathways as Sonic the Werehog faces groups of glowing enemies in the dark of night.

In this exotic sandstone city, Sonic the Werehog encounters groups of enemies and uses his incredible strength to drag massive crates and lift heavy doors.
(Available only on the PLAYSTATION 3 & Xbox 360)
It’s a good thing Sonic is covered in fur since he’ll have to maneuver through these icy caverns! His cast-iron grip allows him to swing from giant icicles.
In this high-rise metropolis, Sonic the Werehog faces fierce enemies and unforeseen obstacles.
